The widget refreshes every 15 minutes. Running times tick live in between. Tap ⟳ to refresh now, tap a notebook to open it, or tap the title to come back here.\n\nOnly committed runs (Save Version) show up. Interactive editor sessions aren\'t visible through the Kaggle API.
